ns2:course.label: Seminar in African History
ns2:course.description: Topics will be listed in the department's course guide at http://www.history.illinois.edu. Same as AFST 511. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours if topics vary. Prerequisite: One upper-level African history course.
